# Foundation

The EVGA GD Series of power supplies builds upon a Solid Gold Foundation. Available in 700W, 600W and 500W, these power supplies are engineered with the same level of performance at a great value. Featuring 80 Plus Gold certified efficiency and a reliable Japanese main capacitor, the EVGA GD Series is a great choice for those looking for a great quality power supply at a great price.

 

## Standard Form Factor

Will fit most mATX, ATX, E-ATX, HPTX, and XL-ATX cases.

## All black sleeved cable

Get that high-end look while staying within your budget.

## Game-Ready Performance

The GD power supplies prove that high-performance gaming doesn't belong to only high-priced power supplies. See the accompanying chart to find out which GD power supply is the right choice for your next EVGA GeForce RTX™ or GeForce® GTX gaming card.

# Power Charts

 

 

 

# Features

 

##### Gold rated efficiency

80 Plus certification ensures your power supply isn't wasting power and turning it into excess heat. Under typical load, this power supply is 90% efficient or higher.

 

##### Reliable Japanese Main Capacitor

Get the most reliability and performance with the use of a high-quality Japanese main capacitor.

 

##### To protect and to serve

This PSU will cover your circuits with complete protection: OCP, OVP, OTP, OPP, and SCP.

 

##### DC to DC Converter

Voltage step-down for rock-solid power, stability, and minimal signal noise (for 3.3V and 5V).

# World leading

 

## World leading EVGA warranty and support for 5 years.
